overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a strong, highly targeted academic and professional social media presence across LinkedIn, Bluesky, and Mastodon. With a combined following of 3,580 users, his content resonates deeply with individuals interested in computational social science, disinformation studies, and academic opportunities. Across all platforms, his posts achieve robust engagement rates, reflecting a highly active and relevant audience.

contentThemes.description: Research updates, papers, and presentations focusing on coordinated inauthentic behavior, disinformation campaigns, and information operations.
Announcements regarding research software updates (such as CooRnet v2.0) and methodological discussions in social data science.
Hiring posts for postdoctoral researchers and recruitment of PhD students interested in computational social science.

recommendations: Capitalize on Bluesky's high engagement rate by posting more interactive discussions and thread-based summaries of newly published papers.
Improve LinkedIn engagement by incorporating visual media, such as infographics or photos of the research team, alongside grant and hiring announcements.
Increase posting frequency on Mastodon to build momentum, focusing on specialized, deep-dive discussions on open-source tool development.

platformInsights.bluesky: Bluesky serves as a highly active hub with a 6.14% average engagement rate. Users are highly receptive to research announcements and academic opportunities, showing a strong propensity to repost content.
platformInsights.mastodon: Hosted on the academic-focused aoir.social instance, Mastodon delivers a 4.55% average engagement rate. It is an ideal space for technical and methodological discussions with peers, despite lower overall follower volume.
platformInsights.linkedin: With 1,850 followers, LinkedIn is the largest channel, driving strong absolute engagement (average 4.87% engagement rate). Professional announcements like grants and hiring posts perform exceptionally well here.
